data.title: SDIndex: Research Framework & Open Data

text.content: The Sensory Density Index (SDIndex) is a fieldwork protocol for encoding how human bodies perceive built spaces. It converts first-person sensory experience into structured, machine-readable data.

rich_text.plain_text: The Sensory Density Index (SDIndex) is a fieldwork protocol for encoding how human bodies perceive built spaces. It converts first-person sensory experience into structured, machine-readable data.

text.content: The core premise is simple: when you walk into a space — a temple, a concert hall, a restaurant — your body registers information before language does. Light pressure, acoustic texture, material density, temporal rhythm, emotional charge. These signals are real, measurable, and consequential for how memory encodes spatial experience. But they are almost never recorded.
